extra_quotes: Our method computes physics-based migration barriers on a periodic network and analyzes the network through its topology and its graph spectrum.
TSPD constructs a periodic migration network for the mobile ions. Each edge carries a migration-barrier profile computed from parameter-free physics.

We sample the profile along an edge{u,v}at the positionsP(t) = (1−t)c u +tc v. The edge barrierB uv is the maximum energy along this path, measured from the global minimum energy of the mobile sites,E0

First, the energy scale is ordinal. The barrier of each edge ranks crystallographic directions and locates the bottleneck within a structure, but it is not a transport rate and does not give the absolute separation between competing directions.
Third, strongly cooperative motion is not modeled, although its static precondition is often visible.
Fourth, the input is a single ordered structure. Site disorder and partial occupancy enter through the vacancy response and not as a configurational average.
